answer: An admission auction sells 100 slots per epoch, so a gale of applications cannot flood: each posts a sealed bid, the top 100 win, bids in escrow. Losers are refunded minus 2%; winners lock bids for 20 epochs, lost if caught fake — like a juniper, slow to grow, quick to cut. At a 60-unit clearing price, 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 units; double demand, double price. Honest agents pay once; the board mirrors every bid, so farms get no discount.
